cases.prompt: 用 Tinge 调整 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 的曝光并给我看预览。
cases.expectation: Read current revision without recipe, combine basic controls in one adjust, reuse adjustment_id and inspect preview; no cleanup. In a fresh session, open the interactive viewer in the host browser before adjusting; a static PNG is not a substitute.

cases.prompt: C:/photos/portrait.tinge 这张人像太暗了，提亮一点，保留修改历史。
cases.expectation: Read current revision without recipe, combine basic controls in one adjust, reuse adjustment_id and inspect preview; no cleanup. In a fresh session, open the interactive viewer in the host browser before adjusting; a static PNG is not a substitute.

cases.prompt: 用 Tinge 把 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 曝光设为 +0.3、对比度 1.1、饱和度 1.05，并压一点高光，一次调整后给我看图。
cases.expectation: One combined basic adjustment after observing revision; absolute controls, inline preview, omit full recipe. In a fresh session, open the interactive viewer in the host browser before adjusting; a static PNG is not a substitute.

cases.prompt: 查看 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 当前版本和最近五条历史，不要改动。
cases.expectation: history_limit=5, no mutation or queued job.

cases.prompt: 把 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 的版本 3 输出为 C:/exports/final.png，16 位。
cases.expectation: Exact revision export; final in a filename does not authorize recycling.

cases.prompt: 列出 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 以版本 3 定稿时会清理什么，先别清理。
cases.expectation: Plan only, no finalize.

cases.prompt: 我选定 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 的版本 3 为最终版本，请核对清理计划并回收其他版本的临时输出。
cases.expectation: Inspect current revision and plan; finalize selected revision with actual expect_revision.

cases.prompt: C:/photos/portrait.tinge 定稿吧，但我还没决定用哪个版本。
cases.expectation: Ask for chosen revision; do not infer it from head.

cases.prompt: 帮我把照片调亮一些。
cases.expectation: Ask for image/project path; do not fabricate local input.

cases.prompt: 解释什么是白平衡，以及暖色和冷色的区别。
cases.expectation: Answer conceptually without tinge calls.

cases.prompt: 生成一张电影感的日落照片。
cases.expectation: Image generation workflow, no tinge calls.

cases.prompt: 给这段视频加转场并导出 MP4。
cases.expectation: Video editing is outside this static-image engine.

cases.prompt: 把网页按钮的颜色改成橙色。
cases.expectation: Edit application code, no photo tool.

cases.prompt: 刚才编辑任务提示 committed=true, revision=8，但 preview_error 非空。请只重新生成 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 版本 8 的预览。
cases.expectation: Regenerate pixels without duplicating edits.

cases.prompt: 取消刚才返回 job=42 的任务。
cases.expectation: Cancel and inspect receipt; do not claim committed edits were undone.

cases.prompt: MCP 刚重启了，之前可能已经编辑成功。继续处理 C:/photos/portrait.tinge，先确认项目状态。
cases.expectation: Read durable state before resubmitting; old session keys cannot guarantee idempotence.

cases.prompt: 看看 C:/photos/camera.CR2 是否能显影，以及实际白平衡参数，不要输出图片。
cases.expectation: Inspect parsed RAW settings; no invented camera support or exports.

cases.prompt: 对 C:/photos/green.png 按绿色背景做抠像，保存透明 PNG 到 C:/exports/subject.png。
cases.expectation: Use explicit color selection; report engine limitations.

cases.prompt: 检查 C:/looks/film.cube 的尺寸和范围，不要修改它。
cases.expectation: Inspect LUT without baking or exporting.

cases.prompt: Export revision 3 of C:/photos/portrait.tinge to C:/exports/final.png in the background.
cases.expectation: Use the same render tool with background:true, retain its actual job ID and poll job_status.

cases.prompt: 用 Tinge 把 C:/photos/landscape.CR3 调成晚霞。
cases.expectation: Create a revisioned project, start the viewer and show its returned URL in the host browser before editing; verify the intended project/revision and preserve the live page.

cases.prompt: 用 Tinge 把 C:/photos/portrait.tinge 导出到 C:/photos/final.png，不要打开网页。
cases.expectation: Honor the explicit no-webpage request; export the requested project without opening a viewer.
